content: Rules for the definition of a splitkey at M2 level The splitkey of a splitable property shall consist of the following parts: • The attribute(s) which define(s) the identity of the aggregated or associated type, in particular:  shortName , if the aggregated type is a Referrable ,  shortLabel , ident.shortName , definition , or other special at- tributes, if the identity of the aggregated type is based on special attributes,  role name of the association, if the splitable property is a reference to an- other element,  role name of the splitable property (name of instance reference) plus the role names of all sub-references, if the splitable property is an instance reference to another element • variationPoint.shortLabel , if the splitable property is stereotyped with atpVariation • The role name of the splitable property, if the aggregated type does not have attributes which define the identity. 267 of 497  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 202: AUTOSAR_TPS_GenericStructureTemplate Generic Structure Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11
